text:
ashwin: Quick check — NL1 rollout: do we have a final owner for cache-aware routing policy and KMS residency? I have a PR but need a quick owner to approve canary.
jen: I can own the routing policy. What's the exact change so I can review?
ashwin: Adds a route key prefix to prefer NL1 for customers with residency=nl and enables prefix caching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482
kevin: pinging eng-runtime to confirm KV-cache invalidation behaviour across regions — @maria any gotchas we should be aware of?
maria: runtime note: KV cache is per-region by default, but we must ensure replication is disabled for nl residency. Otherwise keys leak. Suggest adding `replicate_cache: false` on the deployment config.
ashwin: example config snippet to add to the infra manifest:
```
routing:
  prefer_region: nl1
  cache:
    enabled: true
    replicate_cache: false
```
jen: sg. Also need KMS key — security asked for a dedicated key per region. @josh could you confirm provisioning and IAM?
josh: Yep — we'll provision a NL KMS key and add a restricted IAM binding. Security action: create key + generate secret-manager path. Expect ~2h. Secret path will be `projects/redwood/locations/eu/keyRings/nl/keys/nl-1`.
kevin: who owns wiring that key into secret-manager + infra? I can take the infra PR if needed.
jen: could you take it, kevin? Owner list for this roll: routing=jen, infra=kevin, runtime=maria, security=josh.
ashwin: timeline: canary scheduled tomorrow 10:00 UTC, full cutover Friday EOD. Canary checklist is in the PR description — health checks, traffic shift 5%, fallback policy, and monitoring alerts.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2024-05-02T10:00:00Z by ashwin.
sre-bot: Added incident-ops paging for nl1 during canary window and a short SLA watch.
maria: quick note — runtime unit tests failing on sample_size=1 for the prefix cache; working on a small fix, will push by EOD. This won't block canary but prefer it in the canary image.
jen: thanks. kevin, ping me when infra PR is up, I'll do a quick review (focus on route precedence + feature flag).
kevin: will open infra PR in ~30m and link to ashwin's infra PR.
ashwin: also added a short eval set for nl residency customers in the PR — please make sure monitoring hooks are present so we can detect regressions.
jen: noted. If everyone signs off, I'll merge routing + infra after the canary looks healthy.
kevin: opening PR now.
ashwin: thanks all :thumbsup:
